I am 73 years old. I finished primary school when I was a boy, and I have farmed for 50 years. My farm is only 2.6 mu, just my wife and me. This is all the land we have, so I cannot afford to lose money on it.

Last year I planted cotton on these 2.6 mu and got about 1000 jin of seed cotton per mu. This year I will do the same thing because last year worked fine. I will buy Guoxinmian improved seed — the same kind my neighbor Lao Zhang uses. I need about 2 jin of seed per mu. I will hire the rotary tiller machine to turn the soil before sowing in late April. I always use rotary tillage; it is fast and the machine service charges 50 yuan per mu.

For fertilizer, I will buy three bags of compound fertilizer from the dealer in town. Each bag is 100 jin. I will spread one bag per mu as base fertilizer before sowing. The bag says 15-15-15 but I do not remember those numbers well — I just know one bag per mu is what everyone around here uses. When the cotton starts flowering in July, I will topdress with half a bag of urea per mu. That is about 50 jin of urea per mu. I would rather put a little too much fertilizer than risk a bad harvest. If the cotton does not grow well, I have nothing. Wasting some fertilizer is just money spent; a bad harvest is a disaster.

I have a well, so I will irrigate three times: once right after sowing to help the seeds sprout, once when the plants flower, and once when the bolls are getting big in August. If it rains enough I might skip the last one, but three times is what I usually do.

Cotton always has insects. I will spray pesticide about 10 times this year. I do it myself with my backpack sprayer. I spray for weeds once at the start, then for aphids and bollworm when I see them. Each spray costs about 15 to 20 yuan per mu for the chemicals. I buy the same bottles from the same shop as last year. I do not try new medicine unless my neighbor proved it works on his field.

I expect to harvest about 960 jin of seed cotton per mu this year — about the same as last year. If the weather is good, maybe a bit more. If it is bad, maybe a bit less. But I know my land, and 960 jin per mu is what I can count on.
